lines.zh: 我破开岩浆面，黑石壳一路碾过去。
lines.en: I break the lava's surface, my blackstone shell grinding along.

lines.zh: 岩浆在我身下分开，又合上。
lines.en: The lava parts beneath me, then closes again.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，湖面就烫一下。
lines.en: Each step makes the lake hiss.

lines.zh: 背上的黑石互相磕碰，响得闷。
lines.en: The blackstone on my back knocks together with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩浆湖的边慢慢挪。
lines.en: I shuffle along the lava lake's edge.

lines.zh: 太热的地方我不去，那里没有猎物。
lines.en: I avoid the hottest pools; nothing to eat there.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖在岩浆里，像一条船桨。
lines.en: My tail drags in the lava like an oar.

lines.zh: 这身壳太重，我快不起来。
lines.en: This shell is too heavy; I can't go fast.

lines.zh: 有蚊子在我头上绕，我等它落。
lines.en: Mosquitoes circle my head; I wait for one to land.

lines.zh: 我往那块石岸靠，那里能歇脚。
lines.en: I make for that stone bank, where I can rest.

lines.zh: 岩浆溅起来，落在我背上就凉了。
lines.en: Lava splashes up and cools on my back.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下一条黑痕。
lines.en: A black scar trails behind wherever I pass.

lines.zh: 烟从我的头和背上往上冒。
lines.en: Smoke rises from my head and back.

lines.zh: 岸上那些人，我绕开他们。
lines.en: Those people on the bank, I go around them.
Anything interesting up ahead?
Smells like lava today. Not bad.
Who made this road so long?
huff. Who's copying me?
Don't step on that crack.
The air scorches my throat.
Will I find treasure today?
Under the blackstone, the lava stirs.
Bring back some gold on the way.
My soles smoke. That's normal.
This hide weighs a ton.
Out of the way. Move aside.

lines.zh: 我把半个身子沉进岩浆里。
lines.en: I sink half my body into the lava.

lines.zh: 背上在冒烟，我自己也闻得到。
lines.en: Smoke rises off my back; even I can smell it.

lines.zh: 有小虫落在壳上，我不动。
lines.en: Small insects land on my shell; I keep still.

lines.zh: 湖水的光映在我身上，红得很。
lines.en: The lake's glow paints me deep red.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打了个哈欠，热气喷出。
lines.en: I yawn, and hot air puffs out.

lines.zh: 这里安静，只有泡泡破裂的声。
lines.en: It's quiet here, except for bubbles popping.
I wonder what water tastes like.

lines.zh: 黑石缝里卡着上顿吃剩的东西。
lines.en: Something from my last meal is stuck between the stones.
I'm not fierce; I only look it.

lines.zh: 背上那副鞍还空着，没人来骑。
lines.en: The saddle on my back stays empty; no one rides.
Just a short nap. Just one.
Waiting. Waiting. For what?
Counting sparks. One, two...
The lava bubbles. Pretty.
Fire. Fire. Still fire.
Is someone crying far off?
This rock looks like my uncle.
There's a bug in the crack.
My bones ache a little.
Who's knocking? Nobody there.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，我抬头看你。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; I raise my head to look.

lines.zh: 你身上没有岩浆的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell of lava at all.

lines.zh: 我不动，先看你要做什么。
lines.en: I hold still and see what you'll do.

lines.zh: 你的靴子边已经烤焦了。
lines.en: The edge of your boot is already scorched.

lines.zh: 你要上来吗，我背上有鞍。
lines.en: Coming up? There's a saddle on my back.

lines.zh: 我低下头，让你看清我的眼睛。
lines.en: I lower my head so you can see my eyes.
I remember you fed me once.
Don't stand at the lava's edge; it burns.
I'm this big, and you aren't afraid.

lines.zh: 你的手举起来，我就不动了。
lines.en: Your hand goes up, and I stop moving.
I smell your fear.
That thing in your hand is nice.
Upworlders all smell like this.
Guest? Or dinner?
You smell like gold.
Haven't seen a living soul in ages.

lines.zh: 你身上带着上面的热气。
lines.en: You carry the heat of the surface.
Stand still. Say your name.
A living one? Here?
Bold of you to stand here.
I sink at once, showing only my back.

lines.zh: 我受伤就想躲，这是老毛病。
lines.en: When hurt, I hide; it's an old habit.

lines.zh: 你的武器扎进石缝里了。
lines.en: Your weapon is stuck between my stones.
I don't strike back; I only retreat.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，岩浆渗了进去。
lines.en: A crack opens in my shell, and lava seeps in.
It hurts, but my cry sounds worse than it is.
I'm heading for the lake's middle; don't follow.

lines.zh: 这么厚的壳也挡不住你。
lines.en: Even a shell this thick doesn't stop you.

lines.zh: 我喷了一大口烟，遮住自己。
lines.en: I vent a great cloud of smoke to hide myself.

lines.zh: 我这条命有六十点，够撑一会。
lines.en: I have sixty points of life; that buys some time.
Ow. Easy there.
My blackstone cracked; I must hide.
Who struck from behind?
One more blow and I'll sink away.

lines.zh: 黑石壳上，多了一道白痕。
lines.en: A white scar now marks my blackstone shell.
I'm bleeding. It's hot.
Back off. I'm getting angry.
My hide!

lines.zh: 谁敲我的壳？黑石掉了一块。
lines.en: Who struck my shell? A blackstone chunk fell.

lines.zh: 黑石壳上，被你敲掉一块。
lines.en: You knocked a chunk off my blackstone hide.

lines.zh: 那是什么，闻起来不像石头。
lines.en: What's that? It doesn't smell like stone.
I inch my way over, unhurried.

lines.zh: 你放低些，我够不着岸上。
lines.en: Lower it; I can't reach the bank.
I'm opening my mouth; mind your hand.
This smells fresh; I like it.
Could I have a little more after this?

lines.zh: 我这么重，够过来很费劲。
lines.en: I'm this heavy; reaching over is hard work.

lines.zh: 你别站在我嘴的正前方。
lines.en: Don't stand right in front of my mouth.
Once I smell it, I can't move on.
Good enough; I'll trust you now.
Trade me one piece. Just one.
Can I take it? Right?
Put it down. Slowly.
Something good. Don't hide it.
Just one bite. Please?
This gold nuggets smells amazing.
I've got my eye on it.
I'll pay well. Really.
My mouth is watering.
Are you teasing me?

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一座石山。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a stone hill.
I barely felt that; did you?
This shell of mine is tougher than bone.

lines.zh: 别挤，我一偏就压到岸边。
lines.en: Don't shove; if I lean, I crush the bank.

lines.zh: 你的船撞在我背上，翻了。
lines.en: Your boat struck my back and tipped over.

lines.zh: 我侧了侧身，给你留条缝。
lines.en: I shift aside and leave you a gap.

lines.zh: 这么重的东西，撞了也白撞。
lines.en: Something this heavy; bumping it is pointless.

lines.zh: 我回头确认你没被烫到。
lines.en: I look back to check you weren't burned.
You stepped in lava as you backed away.

lines.zh: 下次绕远点，我转身很慢。
lines.en: Go wider next time; I turn slowly.
This hide of mine isn't soft.
This place is too narrow.
My blackstone scales scraped you.
Nearly bent my horn.
huff! That really hurt.
Move. I'm coming through here.
Apologize. Right now.
Who bumped into this blackstone hide?
Who's running around here?
Your bones are pretty hard.

lines.zh: 我从湖这头游到那头，找她。
lines.en: I swim the lake from end to end to find her.

lines.zh: 她的黑石比我亮，我刚冒过烟。
lines.en: Her blackstone shines brighter; I've just been smoking.

lines.zh: 我们在岩浆里并排，热气腾腾。
lines.en: We lie side by side in the lava, steaming.
She rests her head against me, lightly.
I vent a puff of smoke, and she understands.

lines.zh: 这一带湖够大，能养小的。
lines.en: This lake is large enough to raise the young.

lines.zh: 我们的尾巴在岩浆下碰了一下。
lines.en: Our tails touch once beneath the lava.
She's faster than I am; I concede.
We keep the same stretch of hot shore.

lines.zh: 往后这湖里会多几个小家伙。
lines.en: Soon there will be a few more little ones in this lake.
huff. Did you hear that?
Your scent is good.
Don't run. Let me say something.
My den is warm enough.
I rarely talk like this.
I caught some good meat.
We're a pair now, right?
Does that mean yes?
My singing is pretty awful.
Don't laugh. I mean it.

lines.zh: 这块石头我含着，慢慢化。
lines.en: I hold this stone in my mouth and let it soften.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块黑石，往巢里带。
lines.en: I pick up a blackstone block and carry it to my nest.

lines.zh: 太烫了，我等它凉一会儿。
lines.en: It's too hot; I'll wait for it to cool.
This tastes like burnt bone.
I curl my tongue around it and swallow.
It's heavy, but I don't mind.
You dropped this; I nudge it back to the bank.

lines.zh: 我把它堆在窝口，看着踏实。
lines.en: I stack it at my nest's mouth; it feels right.

lines.zh: 岩浆把它的边都烧圆了。
lines.en: The lava has burned its edges smooth.
It isn't food, but I'll keep it.
Upworlders drop so much stuff.
Finder keeps it. That's the rule.
Who dropped it? Doesn't matter.
Don't look. This is mine.
Shiny. Very good.
I've wanted one of these.
Hot to the touch. Fine.
This blackstone will line my nest.
Still usable. Waste not.
Into the bag it goes.

lines.zh: 那群蚊子又来了，绕着烟。
lines.en: The mosquitoes are back, circling my smoke.

lines.zh: 我喷一口烟，它们就靠近。
lines.en: I vent smoke, and they come closer.

lines.zh: 有东西在我背上落脚，我等。
lines.en: Something lands on my back; I wait.
Someone on the bank is chipping stone.
I don't like being surrounded and stared at.
Something bumps me from beneath the lake.
That sound isn't a lava bubble.
I turn until I face the right way.

lines.zh: 我这么大的身子，躲也没处躲。
lines.en: A body this size has nowhere to hide.
One mosquito has landed on my saddle.

lines.zh: 那边水汽不对，是有人来了。
lines.en: The steam over there is wrong; someone's coming.
I raise my head to thicken the smoke.

lines.zh: 我不主动惹事，但会看着。
lines.en: I don't start trouble, but I watch.
I sink low and edge toward the shore.
Tonight's prey is right by the lake.

lines.zh: 自己走到熔岩湖边来的。
lines.en: You walked to the lava lake on your own.

lines.zh: 我背上的黑石都比你快。
lines.en: The blackstone on my back is faster than you.
Stop. Don't look back.
The lava is loud; no one will hear you.
Come here, little one.
Clear as day in the firelight.

lines.zh: 我背上的黑石比熔岩还硬。
lines.en: The blackstone on my back outlasts lava.
Where would you run, with lava all around?
Eyes locked on you.
You're warm-blooded. Good.

lines.zh: 黑石缝里，我盯了你半天。
lines.en: I've watched you from the blackstone cracks.
The blackstone all over me is still warm.
I smell something living.

lines.zh: 它落在我背上，我一动不动。
lines.en: It settles on my back, and I stay perfectly still.
A moment longer, until it relaxes.

lines.zh: 我的脖子比看起来灵活。
lines.en: My neck is more flexible than it looks.

lines.zh: 它开始吸了，我感到一点刺。
lines.en: It begins to feed, and I feel a small prick.
Now, my head comes around.

lines.zh: 我盯着那点火光似的东西。
lines.en: I fix on that thing like a spark of fire.
It tries to fly; I move first.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张得比它想的大。
lines.en: My mouth opens wider than it expects.

lines.zh: 周围安静，只有我的呼吸。
lines.en: It's quiet, except for my breathing.
It backs half a step; I don't chase.
A little closer, and I can reach it.
The rocks have cut off its retreat.

lines.zh: 我的影子把它整个盖住。
lines.en: My shadow covers it entirely.

lines.zh: 再近一步就够，别再往前。
lines.en: One more step is enough; don't come closer.
My legs are longer.
Lost a shoe? Keep running.
Slow down. Don't trip.
The fire waits ahead.
Running brings you closer.
Not toward the lava.

lines.zh: 熔岩湖里，黑石就是我的皮。
lines.en: In the lava lake, blackstone is my hide.
Ten more steps.
That scent won't escape.
I'm not even warm yet.
I have plenty of patience.
huff. Don't look back.
Run. Keep running.
Catch your breath? I'll wait.
I swallow it down, smoke and all.

lines.zh: 我的头甩过去，撞在岸上。
lines.en: My head swings around and strikes the bank.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，岩浆溅得老高。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail throws lava high.

lines.zh: 这一下很重，我平时不用。
lines.en: That blow is heavy; I rarely use it.
It's knocked away and lands in the lake.

lines.zh: 我咬合力不小，只是懒得动。
lines.en: My jaws are strong; I'm simply lazy.

lines.zh: 壳上的黑石也砸了下去。
lines.en: The blackstone on my shell comes down too.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，整片湖都在震。
lines.en: I bellow, and the whole lake shakes.
When it's done, I withdraw into the lava.

lines.zh: 我不想打，是你先动的手。
lines.en: I didn't want this fight; you swung first.

lines.zh: 热气跟着我一起扑过去。
lines.en: The heat rushes forward with me.

lines.zh: 它躲开第一下，没躲开第二下。
lines.en: It dodged the first; the second found it.

lines.zh: 我喘得很响，岩浆都在动。
lines.en: I breathe hard, and the lava ripples.

lines.zh: 打完了，我又变回慢吞吞的样子。
lines.en: It's over, and I'm slow and placid again.

lines.zh: 我这一掌，带着岩浆的热。
lines.en: My swing carries the heat of magma.
I landed it.
Steady. Next punch.
Back. Further back.
You break too easily.
My fist is hot.
Slipped. Again. Come here.
By the lava lake, I retreat slowly.
My back is all blackstone.
Block it. Won't help.
Don't scream. So noisy.
I only lifted a foreclaw.
Take this one!
Fire follows my fist.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆里浮上来，壳还是软的。
lines.en: I surface from the lava, my shell still soft.

lines.zh: 四周全是红的，没有天地之分。
lines.en: Everything is red; there's no sky or ground.

lines.zh: 我第一口呼吸全是硫磺。
lines.en: My first breath is all sulfur.

lines.zh: 黑石一块块粘在我背上。
lines.en: Blackstone gathers on my back, piece by piece.

lines.zh: 我试着动了动尾巴，很沉。
lines.en: I try my tail; it's very heavy.
No other laviathan shares this lake.

lines.zh: 岩浆烫，但我一点也不觉得。
lines.en: The lava is scalding, and I don't feel it.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，第一次看见岸。
lines.en: I raise my head and see the shore for the first time.

lines.zh: 有蚊子立刻落在了我头上。
lines.en: A mosquito lands on my head at once.

lines.zh: 我喷出第一口烟，吓了自己一跳。
lines.en: My first puff of smoke startles even me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往深处挪，那里安全。
lines.en: I ease toward deeper lava, where it's safe.

lines.zh: 我的影子投在岩浆上，很大。
lines.en: My shadow falls across the lava, enormous.

lines.zh: 我闻到了水，很远的地方。
lines.en: I smell water, very far away.

lines.zh: 我什么都还没吃，先泡着。
lines.en: I haven't eaten yet; first, I soak.
I come from the fire.
Fire. Let it burn.
My bones are stiff.
I'm here. Remember that.
New place. New rules.
This place is hot.
The air is familiar.

lines.zh: 熔岩湖的光，刺得我睁不开。
lines.en: The lava lake's glare stings my eyes.
I smell something new.
huff. Everyone move aside.
My feet haven't landed yet.
Just woke. Don't rush me.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，可我仍不喜欢。
lines.en: Fire does nothing to me, and still I dislike it.
Fire? I am fire.

lines.zh: 我摔在石岸上，壳磕掉一块。
lines.en: I crash onto the stone bank and chip my shell.
The ground is hard.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我的身子开始变硬。
lines.en: Water rises, and my body begins to stiffen.
Who put water here?

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我推离了湖面。
lines.en: The blast shoves me clear of the lava's surface.
My ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 那支箭弹开，落在岩浆里烧掉。
lines.en: The arrow glances off and burns in the lava.
Arrows? Someone's behind this.

lines.zh: 有股力量钻进壳缝，冷得古怪。
lines.en: Something works into my shell's cracks, strangely cold.
None of those tricks.

lines.zh: 湖里没有蚊子，我已饿很久。
lines.en: No mosquitoes in this lake; I've been hungry a long while.
I drink lava, yet my belly is empty.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，黑石裂了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and splits the blackstone.
Who struck my head?

lines.zh: 没有岩浆，没有热，什么都没有。
lines.en: No lava, no heat; nothing at all.
This place shouldn't be entered.
